prompt_text:
TRUE chunky pixel art animation Strip only. Four PICKAXE SWING Frames of exactly the SAME right-facing DWARF MINER shown in the supplied identity reference, in one horizontal row.

Exact 16×24 logical Frames rendered as crisp square Cells; four Frames; two magenta #FF00FF logical gutter Cells; flat magenta keyed background; no labels, margins, extra rows, anti-aliasing, blur, gradients, or dithering.

Copy the reference identity: same short broad body, rust beard, oversized blue lamp helmet, centered amber lamp, black eye Cell without white sclera, green tunic, gloves, leather belt/buckle, broad boots, and the same heavy pickaxe proportions. Use only the first-room Master Palette.

One-shot mining action, not a loop:
Frame 0 — strong anticipation, pickaxe raised behind and above helmet.
Frame 1 — accelerated downswing at head height.
Frame 2 — pickaxe crossing forward, torso and beard following the weight.
Frame 3 — clear ground-level contact ahead of the boots.

Both boots remain planted on the bottom row. The hand stays visibly attached to the handle, face remains separate from the leading hand, and the pickaxe head traces one continuous arc. Frame 3 is the only contact Frame. Do not include rock, terrain, ore, debris, sparks, or a baked target in the character Strip.

Warm rugged storybook pixel art, selective warm-dark outline, neutral upper-left local light. Intended read: heavy committed mining blow with dwarf weight transfer.
